name: Score-based Densification
definition: A purely constructive densification process that steers the addition of new Gaussians toward those that raise reconstruction quality, ensuring model size increases in a controlled manner towards an exact user-defined budget without requiring pruning or culling during training.
summary: Score-based Densification is a 3D Gaussian Splatting strategy that uses gradient and saliency scores to add Gaussians toward a target budget, avoiding the instability of pruning.
